facts.text: The nation's first women's fraternity, Pi Beta Phi, was founded at Monmouth in 1867, and three years later Kappa Kappa Gamma was founded at the College.

sources.title: Fraternity & Sorority Life • Monmouth College
sources.quote: The nation's first women's fraternity, Pi Beta Phi, was founded at Monmouth in 1867. Three years later, Kappa Kappa Gamma was founded at the College.
